diagnosis: The original proof is valid but highly redundant: it proves an unused nonemptiness lemma, expands maximality twice, manually reconstructs elementary set facts, and contains many unreachable tactic chains. The refactor isolates maximality once, pairs every member with its complement outside P, and reduces the cardinal arithmetic directly with `omega`.
proof_body:
by
  classical
  have hmax : ∀ A : Set S, A ∉ P → ∃ U ∈ P, A ∩ U = ∅ := by
    intro A hA
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    exact hPS ⟨A, hA, h⟩
  have hcover (A : Set S) : A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by
    by_cases hA : A ∈ P
    · exact Or.inl hA
    · right
      by_contra hAc
      obtain ⟨U, hU, hAU⟩ := hmax A hA
      obtain ⟨V, hV, hAcV⟩ := hmax Aᶜ hAc
      obtain ⟨x, hxU, hxV⟩ :=
        Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr (hPP U hU V hV)
      have hxA : x ∈ A := by
        by_contra hx
        have hx' : x ∈ Aᶜ ∩ V := ⟨by simpa, hxV⟩
        rw [hAcV] at hx'
        exact hx'
      have hx' : x ∈ A ∩ U := ⟨hxA, hxU⟩
      rw [hAU] at hx'
      exact hx'
  have hnot (A : Set S) (hA : A ∈ P) : Aᶜ ∉ P := by
    intro hAc
    exact (hPP A hA Aᶜ hAc) (by simp)
  let Q : Finset (Set S) := Finset.univ \ P
  have hf : ∀ A ∈ P, Aᶜ ∈ Q := by
    intro A hA
    simp only [Q, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    exact hnot A hA
  have hg : ∀ A ∈ Q, Aᶜ ∈ P := by
    intro A hA
    have hn : A ∉ P := by
      simpa only [Q, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] using hA
    exact (hcover A).resolve_left hn
  have hcard : P.card = Q.card := by
    apply Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ) (fun A _ => Aᶜ)
    · exact hf
    · exact hg
    · intro A hA
      simp
    · intro A hA
      simp
  have hQ : Q.card = (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card - P.card := by
    simpa [Q] using Finset.card_sdiff (Finset.subset_univ P)
  have hle : P.card ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card :=
    Finset.card_le_card (Finset.subset_univ P)
  have huniv : (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    simp
  have hp : P.card * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    omega
  have hn : 0 < Fintype.card S :=
    Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr inferInstance
  rw [show Fintype.card S = Fintype.card S - 1 + 1 by omega, pow_succ] at hp
  omega
